boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 127 feeds numbered discs — `6`, `4`, `5` — into orange-bordered slots across two chambers, with a bottom Lego brick row supplying the color sequence. The orange-bordered purple `2` pillar anchors the center, and the surrounding 2×2 clusters on the right must clear before the pillar can drop. Force the pillar early and it blocks the lower chamber's only feed lane.
landmarks: Block Out Level 127 feeds numbered discs — `6`, `4`, `5` — into orange-bordered slots across two chambers, with a bottom Lego brick row supplying the color sequence.
The orange-bordered purple `2` pillar anchors the center, and the surrounding 2×2 clusters on the right must clear before the pillar can drop.
Force the pillar early and it blocks the lower chamber's only feed lane.

quickTips: Feed the orange `4` into the right `12` chamber before shifting the red 2×2 stack.
The tall purple `2` pillar is the last objective — do not break it until the bottom green `3` lane is open.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Study the bottom Lego row and feed the first matching pair into the left orange-bordered `14` chamber.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Drop the green `6` disc into the left chamber once the `14` slot opens.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Feed the orange `4` disc into the right `12` chamber while the white `5` marker on the right rail is still clear.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the red 2×2 and blue 2×2 stacks on the upper-right without blocking the green 2×2 below them.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Route the pink L-shape and bottom green `3` counter through the lower grid.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Break the tall orange-bordered purple `2` pillar and finish the remaining bottom blue scraps.

failurePoints: Moving the red 2×2 before the orange `4` disc enters the right `12` chamber — this jams the green `3` lane.
Breaking the tall purple `2` pillar while the pink L-shape still blocks the lower grid.
